bounded_host_request.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
root=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai
cd "$root"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = a6a84876ab8ff9a81503ac15d1a3285e50634e1e
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
cid="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=debug-ai --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=debug-ai)"
test -n "$cid"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$cid" | wc -l)" = 1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Health.Status}}' "$cid")" = healthy
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.HostConfig.NetworkMode}}' "$cid")" = host
docker exec "$cid" node -e 'if(process.version!=="v24.20.0"||!process.env.AI_CORE_API_KEY||process.env.AI_CORE_API_KEY.length<16)process.exit(2);console.log("EXISTING_DEBUGAI_RUNTIME_NODE_AND_CORE_CREDENTIAL=PASS")'
p="$root/.worktrees/deepseek-qwen35-command-20261128"
git fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/fix/debugai-scout-diagnosis-handoff-20261016
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 66a19847353fe2ab38c572577f7acbd91837fd3f
if [ ! -d "$p" ]; then git worktree add --detach "$p" 66a19847353fe2ab38c572577f7acbd91837fd3f;fi
test "$(git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD)" = 66a19847353fe2ab38c572577f7acbd91837fd3f
test -z "$(git -C "$p" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
test "$(sha256sum "$p/package.json" | cut -d ' ' -f1)" = "$(docker exec "$cid" sha256sum /app/package.json | cut -d ' ' -f1)"
image="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$cid")"
docker run --rm --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,size=16m --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --user 1000:1000 -v "$p/server:/app/server:ro" -v "$p/orchestrator:/app/orchestrator:ro" -v "$p/scripts:/app/scripts:ro" --entrypoint node "$image" --test server/tests/command-module.test.cjs server/tests/command-model-gate.test.cjs
echo DEBUGAI_COMMAND_MODULE_EXACT_SOURCE_TESTS=PASS_PRODUCTION_UNCHANGED
